meta_title: Gaynor Steele Garden Design | Landscape Designer Birmingham
meta_description: Gaynor Steele Garden Design creates bespoke outdoor spaces across Birmingham. Expert landscape design tailored to your home and budget. Call today for a consultation.
hero_eyebrow: Bespoke Garden Design — Local Birmingham Landscape Expert
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to a space you'll love to spend time in. Gaynor creates gardens tailored to your style, budget, and lifestyle.
services_subhead: From initial concept through to planting and hard landscaping, Gaynor handles every aspect of your garden transformation.

services.title: Bespoke Garden Design
services.desc: Detailed plans tailored to your space, style, and budget. Gaynor listens to your ideas, surveys your garden, and creates a design you'll actually want to build.

services.title: Planting Schemes
services.desc: Expert plant selection for colour, texture, and year-round interest. Gaynor chooses varieties suited to your soil and sunlight, so plants thrive without fuss.

services.title: Hard Landscaping
services.desc: Patios, pathways, raised beds, and water features built to last. Gaynor manages contractors or recommends trusted local tradespeople to bring designs to life.

services.title: Garden Makeovers
services.desc: Full transformation of tired or neglected gardens. From clearing and soil preparation through to finishing touches, Gaynor takes the stress out of a complete redesign.

services.title: Outdoor Entertaining Spaces
services.desc: Design for dining, relaxation, and gathering. Gaynor incorporates seating areas, shade structures, and lighting to make your garden an extension of your home.

services.title: Sustainability & Wildlife Gardens
services.desc: Eco-friendly designs that attract pollinators and wildlife. Native plants, water harvesting, and minimal maintenance create a garden that's beautiful and environmentally conscious.

about_pullquote: I design gardens people actually use and love, not just photograph once.
about_para_1: Gaynor Steele has been creating bespoke gardens across Birmingham for over fifteen years. With a background in horticulture and landscape design, she brings both creative vision and practical plant knowledge to every project. Her approach combines careful listening—understanding how you want to use your space—with expert design that works with your garden's existing conditions.
about_para_2: Clients return to Gaynor because she delivers designs that genuinely improve daily life: gardens that are beautiful, functional, and actually maintainable. She manages the full process from concept sketches through to planting and construction coordination, taking the guesswork out of outdoor spaces. Many of her projects are referred by previous happy clients who recommend her to neighbours and friends.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Gaynor's Designs

reviews.text: Gaynor completely transformed our overgrown back garden into somewhere we actually want to be. She listened to what we wanted, drew up a brilliant design, and then managed all the contractors. She was on site regularly making sure everything was done right. Honestly couldn't fault it.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: We had no idea what to do with our space until Gaynor came round. Within a couple of weeks she'd sketched out a full plan with planting ideas and costings. Even though we only did half of it this year, we've got a clear vision for finishing it. Lovely to work with and really knows her plants.
reviews.author: Sarah W.

reviews.text: Best decision we made was calling Gaynor. The garden is absolutely stunning now—exactly what we asked for but better because she understood the light and the soil. Neighbours keep asking who did it. Already recommending her to friends.
reviews.author: David C.
